4.1.en: Krishna: "I taught this wisdom ages ago to the Sun god, who passed it down." This isn't new content. It's timeless.
4.1.hi: Krishna: "Ye gyaan maine bahut pehle Surya dev ko diya tha, unhone aage pass kiya." Ye naya content nahi, timeless hai.

4.2.en: Wise kings passed it down for generations, but over time it got lost. Even great wisdom fades if nobody lives it.
4.2.hi: Raja log peedhi dar peedhi isse aage badhate rahe, par time ke saath ye kho gaya. Jo jiya na jaaye, woh gyaan bhi kho jaata hai.

4.3.en: "I'm sharing this secret with you because you're my friend and you're open to it."
4.3.hi: "Ye secret main tumhe isliye bata raha hoon kyunki tum mere dost ho aur seekhne ko ready ho."

4.4.en: Arjuna: "Wait, you were born way after the Sun god. How did you teach him?" Fair plot-hole check.
4.4.hi: Arjun: "Ruko, aap toh Surya dev ke bahut baad paida hue. Aapne unhe kaise sikhaya?" Fair plot-hole check.

4.5.en: Krishna: "We've both lived many lives. I remember all of mine. You don't remember yours."
4.5.hi: Krishna: "Hum dono ke kai janam ho chuke hain. Mujhe sab yaad hain, tumhe nahi."

4.6.en: "I'm never truly born and I never change, but I choose to appear in the world through my own power."
4.6.hi: "Main sach mein kabhi paida nahi hota aur kabhi badalta nahi, par apni shakti se duniya mein aana choose karta hoon."

4.7.en: Whenever the world gets really messed up and goodness is losing, I show up. Hope is always loading.
4.7.hi: Jab duniya mein sab ulta-pulta ho jaata hai aur achhai haarne lagti hai, main aata hoon. Umeed hamesha loading hai.

4.8.en: "I come back in every age to protect good people, stop the harmful ones, and reset what's right."
4.8.hi: "Har yug mein main aata hoon, achhe logon ko bachane, bure ko rokne aur sahi ko wapas set karne."

4.9.en: Truly understand who Krishna is, and you won't be stuck in the cycle again. You'll reach him.
4.9.hi: Krishna ko sach mein samajh lo, toh dobara cycle mein nahi phansoge. Unhi tak pahunchoge.

4.10.en: Free from craving, fear and anger, fully focused on the Divine, many people have already made it. You can too.
4.10.hi: Craving, darr aur gusse se free, poori tarah Bhagwan pe focused, kai log pahunch chuke hain. Tum bhi pahunch sakte ho.

4.11.en: However you come to me, I meet you there. Every path people take leads to me in the end.
4.11.hi: Tum jaise bhi mere paas aao, main waise hi milta hoon. Har raasta aakhir mujh tak aata hai.

4.12.en: People who want quick results pray for quick rewards, and they often get them. But quick isn't lasting.
4.12.hi: Jinhe jaldi result chahiye, woh jaldi wale rewards maangte hain, aur aksar mil bhi jaate hain. Par jaldi wala tikta nahi.

4.13.en: People have different natures and strengths, so they do different work. Your role comes from who you are, not your label.
4.13.hi: Logon ki nature aur strengths alag hain, isliye kaam alag hai. Tumhara role tumhari nature se aata hai, label se nahi.

4.14.en: "Actions don't stick to me because I don't crave results." Get this and your work stops weighing you down.
4.14.hi: "Karm mujh pe chipakte nahi kyunki mujhe result ki chahat nahi." Ye samjho, toh kaam bojh nahi lagega.

4.15.en: Wise people before you worked this way and found freedom. So follow their lead and do your work.
4.15.hi: Tumse pehle samajhdaar logon ne aise hi kaam karke freedom paayi. Toh unke footsteps follow karo aur kaam karo.

4.16.en: What counts as action? What counts as doing nothing? Even smart people get confused. Krishna's about to explain.
4.16.hi: Action kya hai? Kuch na karna kya hai? Smart log bhi confuse hote hain. Krishna ab samjhayenge.

4.17.en: Right action, wrong action, and no action all need to be understood. The way of action is deep.
4.17.hi: Sahi karm, galat karm aur akarm, teeno ko samajhna padta hai. Karm ka raasta gehra hai.

4.18.en: Being busy isn't always action, and being still isn't always idle. See through that and you're wise.
4.18.hi: Busy rehna hamesha action nahi hota, aur shaant baithna hamesha idle nahi. Ye dekh liya toh tum wise ho.

4.19.en: Someone whose work has no selfish agenda, whose actions are cleansed by understanding, is truly wise.
4.19.hi: Jiske kaam mein koi selfish agenda nahi, jiske karm samajh se shuddh hain, wahi asli gyaani hai.

4.20.en: Drop the obsession with results, feel complete within, depend on no one. You're working, but it doesn't bind you.
4.20.hi: Result ka obsession chhodo, andar se complete raho, kisi pe depend mat raho. Kaam karte ho, par woh baandhta nahi.

4.21.en: No cravings, mind in control, no hoarding. Just doing what's needed. Nothing bad sticks to you.
4.21.hi: Na craving, mind control mein, na jama karne ki aadat. Bas zaroori kaam. Kuch bura chipakta nahi.

4.22.en: Happy with what comes, unbothered by ups and downs, no jealousy. You act, but stay free.
4.22.hi: Jo mile usme khush, ups-downs se unbothered, koi jealousy nahi. Kaam karte ho, par free rehte ho.

4.23.en: When attachment is gone and work becomes an offering, your karma just melts away.
4.23.hi: Jab attachment chala jaaye aur kaam offering ban jaaye, toh karma pighal jaata hai.

4.24.en: See the divine in everything: the offering, the act, the one who offers, the goal. Then every task becomes sacred.
4.24.hi: Har cheez mein divine dekho: offering, kaam, karne wala, goal. Tab har kaam pavitra ban jaata hai.

4.25.en: Some people worship through rituals, others through pure understanding. There's more than one way to give.
4.25.hi: Kuch log rituals se pooja karte hain, kuch gyaan se. Dene ke kai tareeke hain.

4.26.en: Some practice self-control over their senses, others enjoy the world mindfully. Both can be offerings.
4.26.hi: Kuch senses pe control practice karte hain, kuch mindfully duniya enjoy karte hain. Dono offering ho sakte hain.

4.27.en: Some offer their senses and breath into the fire of a disciplined mind. Self-control as worship.
4.27.hi: Kuch apne senses aur saans ko disciplined mind ki aag mein arpan karte hain. Self-control bhi pooja hai.

4.28.en: Some give wealth, some do tough discipline, some practise yoga, some study deeply. All count if done sincerely.
4.28.hi: Koi daan karta hai, koi tapasya, koi yoga, koi gehri padhai. Sab count hota hai agar dil se kiya ho.

4.29.en: Some focus on mindful eating and breathwork. Even breathing can become a spiritual practice.
4.29.hi: Kuch mindful khaane aur breathwork pe focus karte hain. Saans lena bhi spiritual practice ban sakta hai.

4.30.en: All of them understand what giving means, and giving cleans them up. That's how they move forward.
4.30.hi: Ye sab samajhte hain ki dena kya hota hai, aur dene se woh saaf hote hain. Aise hi aage badhte hain.

4.31.en: If you never give anything, even this life won't work out for you, let alone the next.
4.31.hi: Agar kabhi kuch nahi dete, toh ye life bhi theek nahi chalegi, agle ki toh baat hi chhodo.

4.32.en: There are many ways of giving, and all involve action. Understand that and you're free.
4.32.hi: Dene ke kai tareeke hain, aur sabme action hai. Ye samajh lo toh tum free ho.

4.33.en: Sharing wisdom beats sharing stuff. All action ultimately leads to understanding.
4.33.hi: Gyaan baantna cheezein baantne se bada hai. Har karm aakhir mein samajh tak le jaata hai.

4.34.en: Find a real teacher. Be humble, ask questions, and help out. That's how wisdom gets passed on.
4.34.hi: Ek sachcha guru dhoondo. Humble raho, sawaal poocho, seva karo. Gyaan aise hi milta hai.

4.35.en: Once you get it, you won't be confused like this again. You'll see everyone as part of you, and you in me.
4.35.hi: Ek baar samajh gaye, toh aise confuse nahi hoge. Sabko apna hissa dekhoge, aur khud ko mujh mein.

4.36.en: Even if you've made the worst mistakes, wisdom is a boat that gets you across. Nobody's beyond saving.
4.36.hi: Chahe sabse bade galti ki ho, gyaan ek naav hai jo paar le jaati hai. Koi bhi bachne se bahar nahi.

4.37.en: Like fire burns wood to ash, real understanding burns up your past karma.
4.37.hi: Jaise aag lakdi ko raakh kar deti hai, waise asli samajh purane karma ko jala deti hai.

4.38.en: Nothing cleanses you like wisdom. Keep doing your work right, and it shows up within you in time.
4.38.hi: Gyaan jaisa kuch saaf nahi karta. Apna kaam sahi karte raho, time ke saath ye andar se aa jaata hai.

4.39.en: Trust it, stay committed, control your senses, and wisdom comes. With it comes deep peace, fast.
4.39.hi: Bharosa rakho, committed raho, senses control karo, gyaan aayega. Saath mein gehri shaanti bhi, jaldi.

4.40.en: Constant doubt with no trust leaves you with nothing, here or anywhere. Overthinking everything kills happiness.
4.40.hi: Hamesha shak aur bharosa zero, toh na yahan kuch milta hai na kahin aur. Har cheez pe overthinking khushi maar deti hai.

4.41.en: Work without attachment, clear your doubts with understanding, stay grounded. Then actions can't trap you.
4.41.hi: Bina attachment kaam karo, samajh se doubts clear karo, grounded raho. Tab karm tumhe phansa nahi sakte.

4.42.en: Cut through your doubt with the sword of wisdom. Now stand up and do what you need to do.
4.42.hi: Gyaan ki talwaar se apna doubt kaat do. Ab utho aur jo karna hai woh karo.
